recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中布滿中至大型細胞，核為卵圓、腎形或分葉扭曲，胞質豐富呈淡灰紫色細顆粒狀、界限清楚，間夾數顆大型巨核細胞與空泡；這些形態多樣的非典型大細胞即為成片的腫瘤性肥大細胞。
features: Sheets of medium to large cells with abundant pale grey-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Nuclei round, oval, reniform or bilobed/folded, some eccentric, with moderately condensed chromatin
Scattered large megakaryocytes and multinucleated forms among the infiltrate
Residual erythroid precursors and occasional granulocytes between the atypical cells
Extravasated red cells and a fat vacuole in a hypercellular background
describe_en: High-power view of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse replacement by medium to large atypical cells with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and well-defined borders. Nuclei are round, oval, reniform or bilobed, sometimes eccentric, with moderately condensed chromatin. Scattered megakaryocytes and residual erythroid and granulocytic elements are present. The morphology is consistent with sheets of atypical mast cells, compatible with mast cell leukemia; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells show eccentric round nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof and are CD138/light chain-restricted, not tryptase-positive.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicate folded nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli and express lysozyme/CD163 rather than tryptase.
Langerhans cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophilic cytoplasm and are CD1a/langerin/S100-positive.
